I had a brake failure at around 35 mph, with rain, going down a 700ft decline at 30° over half a mile into a traffic light intersection with a state highway, around midnight. Being on a 24" dirt jumper, at that speed, and everything slick with rain, I accepted how fucked I was, and knew it be sheer luck if a car didn't come through the intersection, as I was about to get the red but had to blow through, and plow me over.

I got lucky, my brakes were squealing like crazy very loudly on the rim as they tried to get friction, and the driver in the one lane waiting to go saw me 'skip stopping' like crazy with both my feet and back tire hops to get my speed down. (Foot on tire at that speed with rain actually doesn't work as well as skip stopping and yawing) And like a decent human being, with just a few seconds, tossed on his hazards and partially pulled into the other lane to block for me as I went through the red on that side. And thank goodness they did as another guy who speeding into the intersection as I was nearing it came to a stop as well.

I really lucked out, and that guy saved my life just doing that.
